_doc: Traits of race wave 4. Each is a bag of keys of the trait library (data/traits.json `_doc`). Work speeds are factors on speed (2 = twice as fast). The keys mining_mult, low_pressure_heal, haggler, loot_bonus, mimic and station.pull_bonus come from the race4-hooks track (docs/CONTENT_PLAN.md section 2). Ferrofluid mends walls (hull_mend rate 0.5) but cannot seal a breach (seal 0).

rebuilt_drone.name: Rebuilt drone
rebuilt_drone.blurb: A Lumen Warden in a crew's keeping: a crewmate's repair mends it, not a bed, and it does not breathe.

gatekeeper_optics.name: Gatekeeper optics
gatekeeper_optics.blurb: One lens that never blinks: hits half again as hard at range, and takes triple ion damage.

digger.name: Digger
digger.blurb: Rock gives way: hits rock half as hard again when manning a mining tool or cutting.

gas_floater.name: Gas floater
gas_floater.blurb: Breathes half as much air, and burns twice as easily.

thin_air_bloom.name: Thin-air bloom
thin_air_bloom.blurb: In a room under half its air, a Siltborn mends a hit point a second.

glint_eye.name: Glint-eye
glint_eye.blurb: Knows what a thing is worth by its shine: station prices are 10% lower while one is aboard.

pocketed.name: Pocketed
pocketed.blurb: Pockets everywhere: one more roll on wreck, salvage and loot tables while aboard.

carapace.name: Carapace
carapace.blurb: A broad shell: takes 30% less from melee and ranged hits.

dock_hauler.name: Dock hauler
dock_hauler.blurb: Union dockers restock racks and stores half again as fast.

shell_back.name: Shell back
shell_back.blurb: A carapace does not fit in a suit or armour: they wear none.

mirror_skin.name: Mirror skin
mirror_skin.blurb: A smooth surface that shows whoever is near. In a room with another crew member, it copies their best trait.

ferrofluid.name: Ferrofluid
ferrofluid.blurb: Liquid metal does not mind an ion strike: immune to ion damage. Idle, it presses against a wall and slowly mends it.

magnet_hands.name: Magnet hands
magnet_hands.blurb: The salvage intake they man pulls one cell further.
